name: systematics_iem_sl_z6_bubbles_reextracted
description: Same as iem_sl_z6, but fb_pos/fb_neg are re-extracted with gas_iem_sl_z6/ics_iem_sl_z6 in the Stage-2 background (rebuild_bubbles_per_variant.py), rather than reusing the baseline bubble residual. Model 'SL_Z6_R30_T150_C2'. ANCHOR / VALIDATION model: identified with the existing analysis baseline GALDEF (Lorimer pulsar cosmic-ray sources, z_h=6 kpc, R=30 kpc halo radius, T_S=150 K HI spin temperature, E(B-V) cut 2 mag). Included as a consistency check -- its fit is expected to closely match baseline_rho2 -- NOT an independent excursion; exclude it when computing the systematic spread over this group.
